title: Identification of a selective pyruvate dehydrogenase kinase 1 (PDHK1) chemical probe by virtual screening.
summary: Hit validation corrected the active isomer; subsequent medicinal chemistry yielded a selective biochemical and cellular probe. Final probe is a joint AI-and-experimental outcome.
organization: University of Michigan; Numerion Labs (United States); Cayman Chemical (United States)
